cards.text: Gabriel, the angel who stands in the presence of God, told an old priest named Zechariah that his wife would have a son (Luke 1:13, 18-19). Now she's pregnant (Luke 1:24), and in the sixth month, God sends Gabriel out AGAIN. This time he's headed to a town in Galilee.

cards.question: God sends the angel Gabriel to a town in Galilee called ___.

cards.text: Gabriel is headed to a virgin who's pledged in marriage to a man named Joseph. And Joseph is of the house of David.

cards.question: Gabriel is sent to a virgin pledged in marriage to Joseph. What's her name?

cards.text: The angel appears to Mary and says, “Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.” Friend, I spent years in the back of a junk drawer, and the nicest greeting I ever got was somebody digging past me yelling, 'WHERE is the TAPE?'

cards.question: An angel just showed up and called Mary highly favored. True or false: Mary is perfectly calm about this greeting.

cards.text: Mary is greatly troubled, wondering what kind of greeting this even is. So Gabriel tells her, “Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.”

cards.question: Gabriel tells Mary she will conceive and give birth to a ___, and she is to name the baby ___.

cards.text: Gabriel keeps going: this baby will be great, and the Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David. And he is NOT done.

cards.question: Gabriel says Mary's son will be great. What will He be called?

answers.text: The Son of the Most High

cards.question: Mary's son will reign over the house of Jacob. True or false: Gabriel says His kingdom will one day come to an end.

cards.text: Now Mary has a question for the angel. Not a scream. Not a faint. A question.

cards.question: Gabriel has told Mary she'll have a son. What does Mary ask him?

answers.text: How can this be since I am a virgin
Why would God pick someone like me
When exactly will the baby be born

cards.text: Gabriel doesn't leave her hanging. The angel replies and tells her how it's going to happen.

cards.question: Gabriel tells Mary how this will happen. Who will come upon her?

cards.text: Gabriel says the power of the Most High will overshadow her. So the Holy One to be born will be called the Son of God.

cards.question: Gabriel points Mary to someone in her own family. Which relative of Mary's, once called barren, has conceived a son in her old age?
True or false: Gabriel tells Mary that no word from God will ever fail.
Gabriel has told Mary everything. How does Mary answer him?

answers.text: Let me talk to Joseph first
Give me a sign to be sure

cards.text: Then Mary says, “May it happen to me according to your word.” The angel leaves her, and friend, this story is just getting warmed up.
